title: Entry eligibility and age bands
content: Assessment demo rule: primary applicants are accepted from age 18 through 65 at first enrollment. Applicants aged 60 through 65 require additional underwriting review. Children may be included on a family plan subject to the product's dependent-age rules.

title: Waiting periods and accidents
content: Assessment demo rule: a general illness waiting period may apply after policy inception, while accidental injuries are treated separately. Pre-existing conditions and listed procedures can carry longer waiting periods. The exact schedule must be confirmed against the approved policy wording.

title: Hospitalisation and day-care coverage
content: Assessment demo rule: eligible inpatient hospitalisation and listed day-care procedures can be covered within the selected sum insured, subject to exclusions, limits, waiting periods, and claim documentation. The agent must not promise reimbursement without checking the policy schedule.

title: Claims and cashless workflow
content: Assessment demo workflow: for a planned admission, the member should contact the insurer or network desk in advance for pre-authorisation. For emergencies, notify the insurer as soon as reasonably possible and retain discharge summaries, invoices, prescriptions, and diagnostic reports.

title: Safe data collection
content: The voice agent should collect only qualification details needed for a follow-up. It must never request card numbers, one-time passwords, passwords, or full government identification numbers. Sensitive details should be redacted from transcripts and escalated when required.

title: Premium affordability objection
content: When a caller says the premium is too expensive, acknowledge the concern, ask about their desired protection and budget, and offer a plan comparison or callback. Do not pressure the caller or quote a premium unless it is present in an approved rate table.

title: Human escalation triggers
content: Escalate when the caller asks for a human, disputes a claim, reports a medical emergency, provides conflicting eligibility information, or asks a question that cannot be answered from the knowledge base. Confirm the handoff in the caller's language.

title: Localized conversation principles
content: For Taglish, use respectful po or opo naturally and retain common finance terms such as premium, beneficiary, policy, and coverage. For Bahasa Indonesia, use a warm formal or colloquial register and terms such as cicilan, tenor, denda, and jatuh tempo when relevant. Localization should adapt tone and context, not translate word for word.
